operations.sql: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '10s'

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))
SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $1

SELECT a.id, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors'->CAST($1 AS text)) = 'number' THEN (a.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors'->>CAST($1 AS text))::int END, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.props->'access'->'all') = 'number' THEN (a.props->'access'->>'all')::int ELSE -1 END FROM anchors a WHERE a.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND a.arch_type = 'Root' AND (a.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors'->>CAST($1 AS text) IS NOT NULL OR jsonb_typeof(a.props->'access'->'all') = 'number')
SELECT doc FROM identity_users WHERE user_id = $1

SELECT t.doc FROM identity_users t
	        JOIN identity_lookups lk ON t.user_id = lk.user_id
	        WHERE lk.value_normalized = $1
	          AND COALESCE(t.doc->>'status', 'active') <> 'disabled'

SELECT n1.id, n1.root_id, n1.acl_all, n1.acl_spec, n1.frag, n1.f_firstname::text, n1.f_lastname::text, n1.f_person_id::text FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = $2 OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = $3 OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)))))) AND (e1.arch_type = $4 OR e1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $4)) JOIN g_n_person_d2a57d n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND CASE WHEN n1.root_id = CAST($5 AS uuid) THEN true WHEN n1.acl_spec THEN true WHEN n1.root_id = CAST($6 AS uuid) THEN true WHEN n1.root_id = ANY(CAST($7 AS uuid[])) THEN true WHEN n1.root_id = ANY(CAST($8 AS uuid[])) THEN false ELSE n1.acl_all >= 0 END ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id

SELECT a.id, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors'->CAST($1 AS text)) = 'number' THEN (a.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors'->>CAST($1 AS text))::int END, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.props->'access'->'all') = 'number' THEN (a.props->'access'->>'all')::int ELSE -1 END FROM anchors a WHERE a.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND a.arch_type = 'Root' AND (a.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors'->>CAST($1 AS text) IS NOT NULL OR jsonb_typeof(a.props->'access'->'all') = 'number')

SELECT n1.id, n1.root_id, n1.acl_all, n1.acl_spec, n1.frag, n1.f_firstname::text, n1.f_lastname::text, n1.f_person_id::text FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = $2 OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = $3 OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)))))) AND (e1.arch_type = $4 OR e1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $4)) JOIN g_n_person_d2a57d n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND CASE WHEN n1.root_id = CAST($5 AS uuid) THEN true WHEN n1.acl_spec THEN true WHEN n1.root_id = CAST($6 AS uuid) THEN true WHEN n1.root_id = ANY(CAST($7 AS uuid[])) THEN true WHEN n1.root_id = ANY(CAST($8 AS uuid[])) THEN false ELSE n1.acl_all >= 0 END ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id
COMMIT
